# OIYO Arcade (game.oiyo.net)

> Free browser games from the OIYO family — board, card, puzzle and arcade titles,
> playable instantly with no install. The board games (chess, gomoku, reversi,
> checkers, connect four, janggi) include a built-in AI opponent with three difficulty levels.

## Site role in the OIYO family
- game.oiyo.net — play (this site)
- oiyo.net — interactive tests & tools (canonical execution surface)
- blog.oiyo.net — guides, lessons, explanations
- wiki.oiyo.net — dictionary & definitions
- news.oiyo.net — daily curated news & market briefs
- ai.oiyo.net — AX / AI-native OS showcase

## Key pages
- https://game.oiyo.net/en/ — arcade catalog (all games, 6 locales: en/ko/ja/zh/fr/es)
- https://game.oiyo.net/en/chess/ — chess vs AI
- https://game.oiyo.net/en/gomoku/ — gomoku (five in a row) vs AI
- https://game.oiyo.net/en/sudoku/ — sudoku
- https://game.oiyo.net/en/yahtzee/ — yahtzee (dice)
- https://game.oiyo.net/en/janggi/ — korean chess (janggi) vs AI

## Publisher
Oiyo — https://oiyo.net/#organization
